title: Filtered colimits of sheaves are computed on sections on a site with finite coverings
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] in which every covering family has a finite index set, let $\Lambda$ be a small filtered category, and let $(\mathcal G_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda}$ be a diagram of sheaves of sets on $\mathcal C$ with colimit $\mathcal G$ in $\Sh(\mathcal C)$. Then for every $U\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ the canonical map $\varinjlim_{\lambda\in\Lambda}\mathcal G_\lambda(U)\to\mathcal G(U)$ is a bijection. The same assertion holds for a filtered diagram of abelian sheaves and its colimit in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$, where the canonical map is an isomorphism of abelian groups.

split_report.summary: Statement kept (correct; it is the special case of Stacks Sites 0738(4) where every covering is finite, plus the abelian analogue). Tags checked against tags/tags: 0738 = sites-lemma-directed-colimits-sections, 03CO = sites-modules-lemma-limits-colimits-abelian-sheaves, 00YR = sites-section-sheaves-algebraic-structures; 00YR is not needed by the proof. Proof written by the agent: (1) the sectionwise colimit P is a presheaf colimit (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-colimits-sectionwise, Sites 00VB / Modules on Sites 03CL); (2) P satisfies the sheaf condition for every covering because the covering is finite, the sheaf condition is a finite limit and filtered colimits commute with finite limits (002W, existing leaf lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimits-commute-finite-limits, set and abelian clauses); (3) hence P is the colimit in Sh(C) resp. Ab(C); (4) the comparison isomorphism with the given colimit has Psi as its component at U. This avoids the sheafification route of the Stacks proof (00WI, 00WK, 00WB, finite cocones in filtered categories, quasi-compact objects), which would need three or four further nodes. Mathlib: no statement for sites with finite coverings; the nearest is isSheaf_pointwiseColimit, only for the extensive topology. No Lean in the source repository states the item.

reviewed.note: Reviewed by the lead (opus-relaunch6). Four steps, one new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-colimits-sectionwise (00VB/03CL; combinedIsColimit, Limits/FunctorCategory/Basic.lean:154, verified). Departure from the proof of 0738(4) accepted: with all coverings finite the sectionwise colimit of sheaves is already a sheaf, since the sheaf condition is a limit over a finite category (the equalizer diagram of the covering and its fibre products) and filtered colimits commute with finite limits in sets and abelian groups (lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimits-commute-finite-limits, the argument Stacks uses in 0F4E); so it is the colimit in the full subcategory of sheaves, and its component at U is the canonical map. Stacks' route through quasi-compact objects and the local description of sheafification is not needed.
